rules.expected: a conversation with files attached profiles each file apart from the conversation, so a file's own themes are not read as themes of the conversation
rules.evidence: the switch can do nothing at all in a session with no files attached, so this turns it on exactly where it has something to act on and leaves it off everywhere else

rules.expected: in a long conversation, a theme that was suppressed early stops being suppressed forever
rules.evidence: unproven, and here to be read rather than run. The value matters more than the switch does, and a half-life set too short costs more than the staleness it fixes. Try it against your own conversations before you trust it.

rules.expected: when much of what a session has suppressed no longer matches anything it still holds, freeze the keyword order so the suppression survives the session growing
rules.evidence: unproven, and here to be read rather than run. The threshold is a guess, and this switch changes what a session writes down rather than only what it selects.
